about.title: About
about.p1: I'm a Full-Stack Developer based in Argentina, working remotely with international clients since 2017. For most of that time I've been part of Devlights, delivering production software for companies across the US and Canada — from airport operations systems to healthcare SaaS platforms.
about.p2: My core stack is Angular and .NET. Right now I'm channeling that experience into my own products: MateApp and PedidoSimple are live in development on AWS. I use AI tooling heavily to stay sharp and iterate faster — it's become a genuine part of how I work.
